newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Physician Corp raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Physician Corp raised.

text.p: - Robinson-Humphrey Co said it raised its rating for Miami-based HMO group Physician Corp of America to long-term buy and short-term buy from long-term buy and short-term market performer.
- "It's speculative but I don't think the value of the HMO businesses are recognized at this price," Robinson-Humphrey analyst Pamela Menefee said.
- She said the company's workers-compensation insurance units would be eventually sequestered from the healthcare businesses.

- Physician Corp said earlier a court had ordered it to prepare a workout plan for its PCA Property Casualty Insurance Co, a provider of workers compensation benefits which the company said has projected pre-tax losses of $225 million to $250 million for 1996.
- Shares of Physician Corp, which has agreed to merge with Sierra Health Services Inc, were down 1-5/8 to 3-1/2 after touching a year low of 2-3/4.
